name: fortify-dashboard
description: Interactive security inspector and real-time threat evaluation dashboard for FortifyJS.

paragraphs: An interactive, client-side web application for real-time testing, visual exploration, and demonstration of the FortifyJS zero-dependency Web Application Firewall (WAF) and Generative AI Guardrail engine.
This dashboard provides a standalone security evaluation workspace running entirely in the browser:
features: 5-Stage Live Architecture Pipeline: Real-time visual trace showing how every payload moves through the Fast-Path Filter, Tri-Variant Normalizer, Lexical AST Tokenizer, Shannon Entropy Profiler, and Runtime Sink Gate.

AST Lexical Token Decomposition: Interactive token stream visualizer breaking raw strings into color-coded grammatical tokens (Keywords, Operators, Identifiers, Sinks, Tautologies) with security risk highlights.
Live Shannon Information Entropy Meter: Dynamic calculation of $H(X)$ bits of uncertainty per byte, visually distinguishing natural language from obfuscated shellcode and binary payloads.
WAF Payload Scanner: Real-time evaluation across 15 web attack vectors (SQLi, XSS, CmdI, Path Traversal, SSRF, NoSQLi, Prototype Pollution, SSTI, XXE, CRLF, Open Redirect, LDAP, GraphQL).
AI & Prompt Guard: Interactive evaluation of adversarial prompt injections, DAN roleplay jailbreaks, delimiter injection, and system prompt exfiltration.
